## RQ 1

## Regimes by Year

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

props <- function(variable){
democracy_data |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(prop = mean(.data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE))
}

vars <- c("is_monarchy", "is_commonwealth", "is_presidential",
          "is_colony", "is_communist")

result <- map_dfr(vars, function(var) {
  props(var) |>
    mutate(variable = var)
})
result
```
